headline: Battle Lines Stir Across Six Active Sectors
war_summary: The newest ledger keeps Weathered Expanse at the head of the war desk, with 53 base events in 24 hours and three in the latest two-hour watch; its holdings remain split three Warden, three Colonial, and three neutral. Marban Hollow has grown busier, rising to 35 daily events, with five recently recorded and a four-Warden, three-Colonial, one-neutral balance. Nevish Line remains unsettled at 38 events, though none landed in the latest two hours; five Warden, two Colonial, and one neutral bases are listed. Linn Mercy has eased slightly to 23 daily events, but fighting is intensifying sharply by the casualty ledger, and its two latest events leave two Warden, eight Colonial, and one neutral base. Mooring County has quickened to 15 events, including two at the cutoff, while holding eleven Warden bases and one neutral. Stlican Shelf now reports seven events, two recent, with eight Colonial, one Warden, and no neutral bases. Elsewhere, Kuura Strand’s activity is older, Stonecradle shows only five daily events, and many sectors remain quiet despite scattered enlistments.
